_about: The nightly job list (B448 P5, ADR-209 item 4). To add a job, add ONE entry here and nothing else: tools/nightly/run.py, ./verify and the workflow never change. name: unique. command: a shell line run from the repo root; it must exit 0 to pass. platforms: any of linux, macos. floor: the fewest cases the job must judge; 0 means it is not a corpus loop. A job with a floor must print the line KIT-GATE cases=<n>; a job that cannot run here prints KIT-GATE skipped: <reason> and exits 0, which the receipt records as skipped, never as ran. See tools/nightly/README.md.
